metrics.measurement_scope: Offline fixed-input generation+PNG/comparison writing; excludes API queue/network, request preprocessing and coexistence with Hair/Nails.

findings: Makeup is clearly visible and fuller/more reference-like than the hand-rendered prototype.
054109: altered eye shape, nose, mouth/smile and face proportions; complexion/skin texture changed.
056266: substantially changed eyes, nose, lips/teeth display, expression and skin finish.
006553: altered eye/nose/mouth geometry and expression; face appears reconstructed.
035149: substantial eye/nose/lip/expression and texture changes; skin finish/lightness changed.
Reference feature influence is suspected from visual resemblance; no causal ablation or biometric identity score was run.
visual_review.decision: Runtime/memory feasibility passes this isolated T4 trial; face/complexion preservation fails the visual screen.
limits: Four reused development portraits, one reference, one configuration; no generalization or all-style approval
Reported4.9GiB reserved is standalone peak, not simultaneous Hair/Nails capacity proof
No claim of a guaranteed parameter fix or cross-model quality-equivalent speedup
This uses external pretrained Stable-Makeup; not a newly trained BeautyCore model.
visual_review.next: No automatic deployment or further GPU sweep. Surface the preservation failure for review; retain working system and separate trial evidence.
